notes.title: Release tomorrow with -10% discount!
notes.notes:
Hi demons! 

Tomorrow is the day! Are you ready to make a pact with a demon? Will you lose or save your soul?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35792989/fb1e8c0263cf19c31117cb10eec14bf81e10bdf5.gif

Tomorrow "Demons Never Lie" will be available on Steam! And to celebrate it, the game will be launched with a 10% discount!

Demons Never Lie is a dark and creepy story about life, death, karma, reincarnation and... demons of course!

How different your life could be if you had taken all the right decisions?
